relations.subject: n1ql:alter-group
relations.evidence: To execute this statement in the Capella UI, you must have one of the following roles: * [Organization Owner](../../organizations/organization-user-roles.md#organization-role-organization-owner)

relations.subject: n1ql:alter-group
relations.evidence: You cannot execute this statement using [cluster access credentials](../../clusters/cluster-rbac.md).

relations.subject: n1ql:alter-group
relations.evidence: Use the ALTER GROUP statement to modify an existing group within the Couchbase Server Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system. You can update the group's description and its roles.

relations.subject: n1ql:alter-group
relations.evidence: When you update a role for a group, all users in the group inherit the updated permissions automatically.

relations.subject: n1ql:alter-group
relations.evidence: If you want to add or remove specific roles without affecting the others, use the [GRANT](grant.md) and [REVOKE](revoke.md) statements instead.

relations.subject: n1ql:alter-group
relations.evidence: To create a group, see [CREATE GROUP](creategroup.md).
